messages:
alice: Planning a controlled config flip at 15:00 UTC — router + runtime + console. 30m quiet window. We expect a brief surge. Need: pin versions, canary percent, and rollback thresholds. @ben @carla
ben: Router pinned to router-v4.0.1-rc (not full canary). console gets 1.9.2, runtime stays on runtime-2.3.1-quant. Any reason runtime can't bump?
carla: Runtime bump would need kernel handshake; let's avoid for this small config flip. Keeping runtime v2.3.1 is safest.
sam: Deploybot dry-run passed on staging. Snippet: `deploybot run --staging --dry-run --services router,console,runtime`
maya: Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-04-15-config-flip (short list). console change: feature flag toggle for telemetry sampling. Router: header swap for route-stability
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled rollout at 1748888000. Planned traffic ramp: 0% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 20m. Canary route tag: cfgflip-2026-04-15
alice: Rollback criteria proposal: if 95th latency increases >30% OR error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m, immediate halt + auto-rollback. agree?
ben: :thumbsup: agree to thresholds. Also add token-level cost spike >20% as a secondary trigger.
carla: Ops note: console schema change requires DB migration - running non-blocking migration. If migration lag >2min for any shard, abort.
sam: I'll watch rollout and metrics. I'll keep console pinned to old variant if any spike. ping me at 15:02 if something looks off.
maya: :eyes: I'll send a short post-release digest to #release-notes when done.
deploybot: deploybot: starting rollout (0% -> 5%) — cfgflip-2026-04-15 — instances: router(12), console(8), runtime(16)
ben: Seeing small latency bump +5% on router p95, within expected. continuing.
alice: Hold at 20% ramp for 5m to observe KV cache pressure. If eviction rates rise >10%, we'll pause and revert to router-v4.0.0.
sam: Eviction spike hit 11% at 15:10. Pausing ramp. initiating rollback of router to v4.0.0-canary-keep
deploybot: deploybot: rollback initiated for router. status: rollback_in_progress. Will post final status.
alice: Thanks. Cancelling console ramp too. Postmortem note: need warmed KV cache plan next time. I'll file follow-up.
maya: Filed follow-up: https://redwood.internal/tasks/KT-482 - add warming during quiet window
deploybot: deploybot: rollback complete. final_status: partial-rollback (router back to v4.0.0, console/runtimes stayed on original).
sam: All checks green. reopening normal ops. :white_check_mark:
